listing.description:
Sol Explorer is the first-person side of the Sol universe: a standalone WebGL tactical and exploration game that moves from neural boarding-torpedo assault, through close-quarters derelict-hulk combat, into deep-space Glyphship exploration without turning those experiences into separate applications.

Players can start at any stage. The full campaign begins in a brain-linked boarding torpedo, transfers into a derelict hulk, drives toward a reactor-overload objective and then opens into deep-space exploration. Derelict Hulk and Glyphship Explore can also be launched directly for testing or free-form play.

Glyphship Explore supports continuous first-person flight, warp, inertial or coupled velocity, weapons, point defence, mining, extraction, salvage, cargo, trade, missions and interstellar navigation. The Navigation Lattice combines local tactical contacts with a wider galaxy view, while procedural sectors provide an independent sandbox whenever the canonical Sol System authority is unavailable.

When connected to Sol System, Explorer enters the persistent canonical universe rather than inventing a separate seed. The client receives strategic bodies, stations, fleets, faction state, missions, construction, player progression and live pilot presence while retaining immediate local authority over flight, aiming and rendering. Strategic ticks move the world without snapping or rebuilding the active cockpit simulation.

The world now extends beyond the pilot seat. Solid off-ship avatars and weapons support first-person movement through stations and O'Neill habitats, including rotating gravity frames, city spaces and walkable structures. Large canonical battles bring active fleets, station batteries, fighter wings, missiles, capital weapons and long-range contacts into the same first-person scene.

Public multiplayer can connect several Explorer pilots to one canonical universe with shared missions, battles, invasions, wrecks and salvage. Player flight remains primarily client-simulated today and PvP weapon impacts are not yet fully server-authoritative. The Showcase build therefore runs the supported standalone procedural mode when the private canonical bridge is absent, while shared authority features are clearly unavailable rather than simulated.
features: first-person derelict-hulk combat and Glyphship exploration
Procedural standalone universe plus optional persistent canonical Sol System universe
Navigation Lattice with local tactical contacts
sector mapping and wider interstellar route planning
listing.summary: A first-person sci-fi exploration and combat game spanning boarding-torpedo assaults, derelict hulks, Glyphship flight, O'Neill habitats and a persistent canonical universe shared with Sol System.
listing.tagline: Board the hulk. Pilot the Glyphship. Explore the living Sol universe.
